# GARDA RTL Explorer

GARDA hardware explorer for Hackathon ITS 2026, with SENO-inspired blue, cyan, and yellow.

This folder is the self-contained static website distribution. Serve it over HTTP, or deploy it to GitHub Pages or Vercel. JavaScript modules, fonts, Three.js, source snapshots, evidence data, and downloadable project bundles are included locally.

Canonical source and maintenance instructions: https://github.com/wlmoi/GARDA/tree/main/dashboard

The 3D model explains the architecture and is not a measured GDS floorplan or official mechanical CAD. Browser gate interaction is a JavaScript behavior model verified against RTL, not a live motor controller.
